description: offset is the skip alias and also accepts a parameter; one leading $ is stripped.

age.statement: SELECT * FROM cypher('age_graph', $$ MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.name SKIP $o LIMIT $l $$, %s) AS ("name" agtype)

sql_pgq.statement: SELECT * FROM GRAPH_TABLE (graph_table MATCH (p IS "Person") COLUMNS (p.name)) LIMIT $l OFFSET $o

duck_pgq.statement: SELECT * FROM GRAPH_TABLE (graph_table MATCH (p IS "Person") COLUMNS (p.name)) LIMIT $l OFFSET $o
